agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: The opening scorer initially ignored the speed tie-break between equal-priority Fake Out users and suggested Sludge into a preventable flinch.

resolution.observed: The shared priority comparator now uses effective speed for equal priority; the exact regression and all 235 tests pass.

findings.observed_fact: Croakatoa was faster and its Fake Out safely flinched Makuhita before Makuhita could act.
findings.strategic_judgment: Winning equal-priority Fake Out is free damage and tempo; slower damage must not replace it.
findings.next_test: Require the corrected shared scorer on the next Dewford trainer without profile code.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The authoritative live state advanced; the exact RAM fixture and transaction hashes are preserved.

findings.summary: Guts initially removed only the burn penalty instead of applying the 1.5x physical Attack boost for any major status.

resolution.observed: Shared damage mechanics now apply Guts to burn and poison; exact bounds contain the observed Bullet Punch and all tests pass.

findings.observed_fact: Poisoned Makuhita dealt 16 damage with Bullet Punch, above the old estimate.
findings.strategic_judgment: Underestimating a status-activated attacker can convert a safe continuation into an avoidable faint.
findings.next_test: Verify status-activated abilities continue to affect every physical move estimate.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The live state advanced; exact pre/post transaction hashes and regression stats are preserved.

findings.summary: Opponent Fake Out remained falsely legal after its entry turn because enemy freshness was not reconstructed from persisted transactions.

resolution.observed: BattleHistory now reconstructs opponent freshness and constrains stale Fake Out; restart and scorer regressions pass.

findings.observed_fact: Makuhita had already spent its entry turn, but the old candidate set continued to include Fake Out.
findings.strategic_judgment: A stale priority threat distorts KO, survival, and switch rankings.
findings.next_test: Pass one stable battle_id through every evaluate and step call on the next trainer.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The live state advanced; persisted battle transactions reproduce the history.

findings.summary: Iron Fist and Muscle Band were omitted, understating Ledian punch damage.

resolution.observed: Shared damage bounds now stack Iron Fist and Muscle Band; ThunderPunch is 16-20 and observed 18 fits.

findings.observed_fact: ThunderPunch dealt 18 while the old bound was 13-16.
findings.strategic_judgment: Stacked attacker modifiers must be modeled before declaring a continuation or switch safe.
findings.next_test: Retain modifier stacking in all bench and active damage evaluations.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The live state advanced; the exact observed delta and regression fixture remain.

findings.summary: Missing Sandile fallback typing made Snackodile appear falsely safe against Fighting coverage.

resolution.observed: The shared species fallback now identifies Sandile as Ground/Dark and the switch regression rejects the false safety claim.

findings.observed_fact: Bench scoring lacked Snackodile types even though the active battle evaluator needed them for incoming damage.
findings.strategic_judgment: Unknown bench typing must never be treated as neutral when ranking survival switches.
findings.next_test: Prefer ROM-resolved bench types and fail conservative when neither RAM nor ROM resolves them.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The live state advanced; exact team stats and regression are preserved.

findings.summary: The finishing rule initially treated a slower lethal critical as preempting a faster guaranteed KO.

resolution.observed: Only equal-or-higher-priority replies that act first now block a finish; Spark correctly survived Mach Punch and KOed Ledian.

findings.observed_fact: Ohmnomnom could act before Ledian except for Mach Punch, which could not KO.
findings.strategic_judgment: Threats that cannot occur before a guaranteed KO must not force an unnecessary switch.
findings.next_test: Keep speed and priority ordering explicit in every finish certificate.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The live state advanced; the exact certificate and result are in the transaction log.

findings.summary: Reversal HP scaling and full-HP Focus Sash were absent, so raw Spark damage initially looked like a safe one-turn finish on Mankey.

resolution.observed: Shared mechanics now scale Reversal from current HP and add Focus Sash effective HP only at full health; exact regressions pass.

findings.observed_fact: Mankey entered at 44/44 with Focus Sash and Reversal, making an immediate Spark create a lethal low-HP reply.
findings.strategic_judgment: Damage planning must account for survival items and moves whose power changes after our hit.
findings.next_test: Evaluate threshold-sensitive retaliation before choosing every non-KO damaging move.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: The live state advanced; exact live stats and regression fixture are preserved.

findings.summary: The Reversal safeguard returned Nuzzle before comparing critical-safe switches, exposing Ohmnomnom to a possible Power-Up Punch critical faint.

resolution.observed: Scorer v23 retains the safe Reversal threshold but continues into survival ranking; the exact live-stat regression now selects full-HP Lildozer and all 235 tests pass.

findings.observed_fact: Nuzzle succeeded, but Power-Up Punch reduced Ohmnomnom from 39 to 13 and a critical could have fainted it.
findings.strategic_judgment: Avoiding a Reversal threshold cannot bypass the higher-priority catastrophic-loss comparison.
findings.next_test: Require critical-safe switch comparison after every move-specific tactical guard.
findings.state_unavailable_reason: No pre-Nuzzle savestate was retained; the full live RAM values and exact transaction were converted into a deterministic regression.

findings.summary: ROM trainer identity reported Cristian and a double format while authoritative live state identified Battle Girl Lilith in a single battle.
findings.observed_fact: map:3:3/local:7 did not match the live trainer name or battle format.
findings.strategic_judgment: Stable overworld identity must link to the live roster before hard-fight preparation can trust it.
findings.next_test: Reconcile the trainer record from live identity and roster before Brawly preflight.

findings.summary: Held item 445 was externally labeled Flame Orb but inflicted poison in the live battle.
findings.observed_fact: Makuhita became poisoned from its held item after the opening turn.
findings.strategic_judgment: Use authoritative live effects until the hack item-name table is decoded correctly.
findings.next_test: Decode item 445 from ROM behavior before using its name in preparation.

findings.summary: Enemy Mach Punch PP was not attributed when Ledian fainted and the next opponent entered in the same transition.
findings.observed_fact: HP and feedback showed a pre-Spark Mach Punch, but enemy_move_id was null.
findings.strategic_judgment: Transition turns should retain the outgoing opponent action for future move-history constraints.
findings.next_test: Add an outgoing-foe PP attribution regression without changing current live progress.

findings.summary: The first final-step call omitted battle_id and was safely refused as a stale certificate.

resolution.observed: The corrected call passed the same battle_id and certificate and executed Spark; the battle skill now mandates identical history context.

findings.observed_fact: The state hash matched but execution rebuilt different enemy-move evidence without battle_id.
findings.strategic_judgment: Evaluation and execution must share one history identity to avoid repeat calls and stale evidence.
findings.next_test: Use --brief with the same battle_id on both calls for the next trainer.

findings.summary: Iron Barbs recoil remains visible only after execution rather than in projected outgoing damage.
findings.observed_fact: Iron Barbs repeatedly chipped contact attackers and changed later KO thresholds.
findings.strategic_judgment: Projected contact recoil could improve threshold selection, but no Lilith action is proven dominated by its omission.
findings.next_test: Model contact recoil only when a bounded regression shows it changes a candidate ranking.

correct_choices: Faster Fake Out converted the opening into free damage and poison tempo.
Guts-aware Sludge followed by priority Vacuum Wave finished Makuhita safely.
The corrected modifier and typing model selected a critical-safe Ohmnomnom pivot into Ledian.
Fresh-entry Fake Out and speed-aware Spark finished Ledian without switch churn.
Nuzzle broke Focus Sash and controlled speed; scorer v23 now improves its critical-risk ordering.
Final Spark was a verified first-hit KO before any reply.
agent_review.next_test: Use scorer v23 and --brief on the next Dewford trainer; fix any bad recommendation in the shared classifier before input.
